maria: Heads-up — starting onboarding for ornitho-13B. Need a quick license/compliance check before we push it to the model-catalog. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/ornitho/13B/v1/weights.tar.gz. Any known tokenizer quirks or config mismatches?

ajay: Got the weights link. Noticed tokenizer normalizes some punctuation in a weird way on our tokenizers v0.14. Example below (using tokenizers):
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(tok.encode('state-of-the-art').tokens)
# -> ['state', '-', 'of', '-', 'the', '-', 'art']
```
This splits hyphen into separate tokens which breaks certain beam-search priors.

dmitri: Config check: model repo had max_seq_len=2048 but binary built for 4096. KV cache logic still fine but mismatch can cause truncation in some tests. Current inference hint: `{\"max_seq_len\": \"4096\", \"kv_cache\": \"true\", \"dtype\": \"fp16\", \"quantize\": \"q4_0\"}` — will push manifest update if folks agree.

kevin: Ping @legal for licensing & attribution requirements. The upstream model card claims CC-BY-NC-4.0 + an extra \"no-healthcare\" clause. What do we need in our model_card to be compliant?

legal-bot: Automated license scan: declared license = CC-BY-NC-4.0 plus additional restricted_uses: [no-healthcare, no-high-frequency-trading]. Actions required: 1) include \"attribution_template\" field in the model card; 2) include \"restricted_use\" entries; 3) for Dedicated/Private customers with commercial intent, require signed addendum. See https://redwood.internal/legal/model-licenses.

maria: I drafted models/ornitho-13B/model_card.md with an attribution line and a short restricted_use section. Pushed to branch ornitho/card-draft. PTAL @sophie for wording.

sophie: Quick wording nit: change \"attribution:\" to \"Required attribution:\" and include example URL format (e.g. \"Model: Ornitho-13B, Source: https://huggingface.co/ornitho/13B\"). Also add an \"allowed_uses\" list (e.g. research, internal tools) to make enforcement easier.

infra-bot: Preflight results: quantization=q4_0 functional tests pass. Performance note: 95p latency on p4d increased by ~8ms vs baseline. Autoscale and pool configs OK.

ajay: Workaround for tokenizer: apply pre-normalizer replace hyphen -> \u200d (zero-width joiner) before encoding, or update tokenizer normalizer. Quick patch:```python
text = text.replace('-', '\\u200d')
tokens = tok.encode(text).tokens
```
I'll add unit to catch \"state-of-the-art\" case.

dmitri: Re-ran validation after ajay's patch — config + tokenizer patch green. Updating model_manifest.json with new hash and license field: `license_declared: cc-by-nc-4.0+no-healthcare`. SHA256: abcdef123456... (pushed to branch).

kevin: Legal confirmed: NC license prohibits commercial distribution; for enterprise customers we will require addendum. Also agreed we should surface attribution in hosted responses (proposal: include header `X-Model-Attribution: Ornitho-13B; Source=https://huggingface.co/ornitho/13B`). Routing/Platform team to implement header for hosted inference only.

maria: Plan: finalize model_card + compliance checklist, open PR to model-catalog, and merge after legal signoff. @ajay can you open CR for tokenizer patch + unit tests? Target EOD for the PR so we can run canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:

ajay: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/models/pull/42 — includes tokenizer fix + tests + manifest update.

infra-bot: Deploybot: Canary deploy scheduled for 03:00 UTC tomorrow to test against canary pool. Will auto-rollback if perf regression > 10% or if functional tests fail.
